card.name: Planets and astronomy descriptions
card.fires_on: Scattered words in general-web passages about planets, stars and fictional worlds, such as 'atmosphere', 'rotational', 'gas' before 'giant', or a comma in a sentence about a sky world. It is not found in drug-label text.

modes.label: Planet descriptors
modes.description: Adjectives or nouns describing a planet or moon, such as rotational, gas, atmosphere, deeper.
modes.example: was used to determine its<< rotational>> axis and a system of latitude and longitude

modes.label: Sentence glue in space fiction
modes.description: Pronouns, commas or adverbs in sentences about life or conditions in an imagined world or on Venus.
modes.example: Most animals have trilateral symmetry, allowing<< them>> to see in all directions.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are a mix of unrelated fragments, with some weather and geography words, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on words in text about planets, stars and their atmospheres, including a sci-fi novel's world.
